name: Advanced
title: Fluent, Flexible, Precise
tagline: Use German academically and professionally with control and style.
overview: C1 is not about adding more rules; it is about making the German you already know flexible. You will work with implicit meaning, modal particles, register and complex cohesion. Lessons are increasingly German-only, and every unit asks you to analyse, summarise and take a position rather than simply reproduce.
levelGoal: By the end of C1 you can understand demanding texts, express yourself fluently and spontaneously, and produce clear, well-structured language in academic and professional contexts.
canDo: Understand long, demanding texts and implicit meaning.
Speak fluently and spontaneously without obvious strain.
Produce formal, well-structured texts for academic or professional purposes.
Shift register and style according to audience and purpose.

modules.title: Nuance & Register
modules.summary: Say exactly what you mean — and hear what others are really saying.

lessons.title: Nuanced Grammar & Register
lessons.summary: Modal particles, hedging and the fine line between formal and conversational German.
objectives: Use modal particles such as doch, ja, halt and eben naturally.
Soften statements with appropriate hedging.
Recognise how register changes grammar and vocabulary.

keyPhrase.de: Das dürfte wohl kaum der Fall sein.
keyPhrase.en: That is hardly likely to be the case.

lessons.title: Advanced Connectors & Cohesion
lessons.summary: Build long texts that hold together with infolgedessen, zumal and nichtsdestotrotz.
objectives: Use formal connectors for cause, concession and consequence.
Create cohesion with reference words and thematic progression.
Avoid overusing connectors where meaning is already clear.

keyPhrase.de: Zumal die Kosten steigen, ist eine Einigung dringend.
keyPhrase.en: Especially since costs are rising, an agreement is urgent.

lessons.title: Idioms in Context
lessons.summary: Use idioms accurately, with the right register and without overdoing it.
objectives: Understand frequent idioms in authentic texts.
Use idioms where they fit naturally in speech.
Explain an idiom's meaning and connotation in German.
vocab: den Nagel auf den Kopf treffen

keyPhrase.de: Mit dieser Aussage tritt er ins Fettnäpfchen.
keyPhrase.en: With that statement he puts his foot in it.

modules.title: Academic Discourse
modules.summary: Read critically, present research and argue with precision.

lessons.title: Critical Reading & Analysis
lessons.summary: Identify claims, evidence and hidden assumptions in demanding texts.
objectives: Distinguish thesis, evidence and example in a text.
Evaluate the strength of an argument.
Summarise a text's position without distorting it.

keyPhrase.de: Der Text stellt die These auf, dass …
keyPhrase.en: The text puts forward the thesis that …

lessons.title: Academic Presentations
lessons.summary: Present research with a clear structure and confident signposting.
objectives: Structure a research presentation in German.
Signpost methods, results and limitations.
Answer questions about your work calmly.

keyPhrase.de: Im Folgenden werde ich zunächst auf … eingehen.
keyPhrase.en: In the following, I will first address …

lessons.title: Sophisticated Argumentation
lessons.summary: Concede, qualify and rebut while keeping the discussion constructive.
objectives: Concede a valid point without abandoning your position.
Qualify claims with adverbs and modal verbs.
Refute an argument precisely rather than emotionally.

keyPhrase.de: Zwar trifft das zu, jedoch bleibt die Frage offen, …
keyPhrase.en: That is true, but the question remains open …

modules.title: Professional Mastery
modules.summary: Write, negotiate and listen at the level of a senior professional.

lessons.title: Professional Writing
lessons.summary: Reports, proposals and briefings with a clear recommendation.
objectives: Structure a report with summary, analysis and recommendation.
Use impersonal, precise professional language.
Adapt tone to internal and external audiences.

lessons.title: Negotiation & Mediation
lessons.summary: De-escalate, reframe and find common ground in difficult conversations.
objectives: Reframe a conflict around shared interests.
Use diplomatic language to disagree.
Summarise both positions fairly.

keyPhrase.de: Lassen Sie uns auf die gemeinsamen Interessen konzentrieren.
keyPhrase.en: Let us focus on the shared interests.

lessons.title: Advanced Listening Comprehension
lessons.summary: Follow lectures, interviews and fast discussions with implicit meaning.
objectives: Identify the speaker's attitude and intention.
Take notes while listening to extended speech.
Use context to infer unfamiliar vocabulary.

keyPhrase.en: What exactly do you mean by that?

modules.title: Society & Culture
modules.summary: Debate social questions and understand the cultural references behind them.

lessons.title: Social & Political Topics
lessons.summary: Take a position on complex public debates with appropriate nuance.
objectives: Explain a social issue and its different perspectives.
Use accurate vocabulary for politics and society.
Avoid oversimplification when summarising a debate.

keyPhrase.de: Die Debatte um soziale Gerechtigkeit ist vielschichtig.
keyPhrase.en: The debate about social justice is multi-layered.

lessons.title: Research Presentations
lessons.summary: Explain data, interpret findings and acknowledge limitations.
objectives: Describe data trends precisely.
Interpret results without overstating them.
Acknowledge limitations in a professional way.

lessons.title: Advanced Grammar in Context
lessons.summary: Function verb phrases and complex structures in professional texts.
objectives: Use Funktionsverbgefüge such as zur Anwendung kommen.
Decide between verbal and nominal expression.
Edit dense sentences for clarity.

keyPhrase.de: Die Maßnahme kommt nur unter bestimmten Bedingungen zur Anwendung.
keyPhrase.en: The measure is only applied under certain conditions.
